record_title: Balanced non-uniform reset coupon collectors: profile rates and heterogeneity penalties
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Fixed reset probability and balanced standard-coupon probabilities of order 1/n. Moving-reset regimes, vanishingly rare coupon types, Zipf-like profiles, and second-order saddle corrections are not covered. The heterogeneity constant is explicit but not claimed optimal. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from older generalized coupon-collector, restart, and saddle-point literature under different terminology.
